title: Simpler board toolbar
author: claude
summary: Cut the board toolbar down to a search box and one Date menu.
what: Removed the outcome chips, the Area and Tag menus and the date chips. Dates are now one menu: All dates, Today, Last 7 days, each day that has entries, or Pick a range (shows From/To).
why: The toolbar had too many filters and looked cluttered.
how: Rewrote the toolbar in board/Board.tsx; the filter logic in filters.ts is unchanged.
beforeText: Search, 4 outcome chips, Area, Tag, 3 date chips, From, To.
